433f_tp_name: ACME Holdings LLC — John Q. Sample
_accounts_split: Was one `accounts` array of three rows until defect D1. The map now binds PERSONAL BANK ACCOUNTS and INVESTMENTS as separate groups, so the fixture supplies them separately — which is the point: the flat array could not say which table a row belonged in, and slot order answered for it.

_deferred_digital_assets._why: The DIGITAL ASSETS (CRYPTOCURRENCY) table is unbound, so this row deliberately prints nowhere. It is kept in the fixture rather than deleted so the read-back has something to prove: a record carrying a crypto wallet must leave the digital-assets table blank, not divert the wallet into a table that IS bound. No group reads this key.
